## Runtime vs. Ratings

this is a short introduction to the analysis of the relationship between movie runtimes and ratings. 



@fig-runtime-ratings shows the relationship between movie runtimes and ratings.

```{python}
#| label: fig-runtime-ratings
#| fig-cap: "Movie Runtime vs Ratings"
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(df["runtime_min"], df["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDB Rating")
plt.show()
```



```{python}
#| label: tbl-mean-rating-by-decade
#| tbl-cap: "Mean IMDB Rating by Decade"
#| echo: true

df["decade"] = df["year"] // 10 * 10
df.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)





```
